summary.text: According to the legislative biography, Linda Ichiyama represents the 31st House District, where she was born and raised, and was elected to office in 2010.

paragraphs.text: She is a graduate of Moanalua High School, Georgetown University, and the William S. Richardson School of Law at the University of Hawaii at Manoa.
The biography says she is one of four co-conveners of the bipartisan Women's Legislative Caucus and titles her Vice Speaker.
